subject: Ciências
description_pt: Discutir e avaliar usinas de geração de energia elétrica (termelétricas, hidrelétricas, eólicas etc.), suas semelhanças e diferenças, seus impactos socioambientais, e como essa energia chega e é usada em sua cidade, comunidade, casa ou escola.

components.description_pt: Descrever como plantas termoelétricas, hidrelétricas e eólicas geram eletricidade
components.description_en: Describe how thermoelectric, hydroelectric, and wind-powered plants generate electricity
components.cc_component_description: Analyze collected data to provide evidence for the relationship between electricity and magnetism

components.description_pt: Comparar diferentes tipos de usinas geradoras de eletricidade quanto aos seus princípios de funcionamento
components.description_en: Compare different types of electricity-generating power plants in terms of their operating principles
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate trade-offs between renewable and nonrenewable energy use in terms of environmental effects

components.description_pt: Avaliar os impactos socioambientais de diferentes tipos de usinas geradoras de eletricidade
components.description_en: Evaluate the socio-environmental impacts of different types of electricity-generating power plants
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the environmental impacts associated with human use of specific energy sources

components.description_pt: Explicar como a eletricidade gerada em usinas é transmitida e usada em casas, escolas e comunidades
components.description_en: Explain how electricity generated at power plants is transmitted and used in homes, schools, and communities

cc_matches.description: Energy and fuels that humans use are derived from natural sources, and their use affects the environment in multiple ways. Some resources are renewable over time, and others are not.
Plan and conduct an investigation to provide evidence that an electric current can produce a magnetic field and that a changing magnetic field can produce an electric current.
